sn42.3:1.1: Atha kho yodhājīvo gamaṇi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.3:1.2: Sutam me bhante pubbakānam ācariyapācariyānaṃ yodhājīvānam bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.3:1.3: Yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati || tam enam ussahantaṃ vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Sarañjitānaṃ devānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti || ||
sn42.3:1.5: Alam gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetam mā mam etam pucchīti || || 4
sn42.3:1.7: Tatiyam pi kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.3:1.8: Sutam me bhante pubbakānam ācariyapācariyānaṃ yodhājīvānam bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.3:1.9: Yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati || tam enam ussahantaṃ vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || ||
sn42.3:2.1: Addhā kho tyāhaṃ gāmaṇi na labhāmi ||
sn42.3:2.2: Alam gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetam mā mam etam pucchīti ||
sn42.3:2.4: Yo so gāmaṇi yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati || tassa taṃ cittam pubbe hīnaṃ duggatam duppaṇihitam
sn42.3:2.5: Ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā ahesuṃ iti vā ti ||
sn42.3:2.6: tam enam ussahantaṃ vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti ||
sn42.3:2.7: so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Sarājitā nāma nirayā tatthupapajjati || ||
sn42.3:2.8: Sa ce kho panassa evam diṭṭhi hoti ||
sn42.3:2.9: Yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati || tam enam ussahantam vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sarājitānam devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || Sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi || ||
sn42.3:2.10: Micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāham gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnam aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi ||
sn42.3:3.1: Evaṃ vutte yodhājīvo gāmaṇi parodi assūni pavattesi || ||
sn42.3:3.3: Alam gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetam mā mam etam pucchīti || ||
sn42.3:3.4: Nāham bhante etam rodāmi yam mam Bhagavā evam āha ||
sn42.3:3.5: api cāham bhante pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi yodhājīvehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paluddho ||
sn42.3:3.6: Yo so yodhājivo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tam enam ussahantam vāyamantam pare hananti pariyāpādenti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 8
